Subject: Request: 2-week micro extension & short surge burst

Hi Marcus,

Hope youre well. Our engineering team hit a blocker in the last mile of our integration and we need an extra two-week runway on the current time-boxed evaluation so they can finish the latency tests. We also expect a short surge (approx 200k tokens) during the final validation window next week.

Can Redwood do a 14-day micro-extension + a one-time surge bucket? We need options that are fast to execute (PO or signed addendum) — procurement prefers a single-line addendum or invoiceable charge vs. moving budget around.

Quick questions:
- Cost for 14 days + 200k token burst?
- Any credit/offset option if we convert to commitment after the pilot?
- Can we get a turnaround timeframe for paperwork (legal/PO friendly)?

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the usage file, that helps. We can absolutely support a short extension + a surge bucket. Two pragmatic options to move quickly: 

1) Fast addendum (recommended): 14-day addendum with a one-time extension fee of $3,000 + a 200k token burst priced at $0.01/token ($2,000). Total: $5,000. Execute via DocuSign or a signed addendum + PO.

2) Credit-offset path: if you convert to a monthly commitment within 30 days of the extensions end, we can apply 40% of the one-time extension fee ($1,200) as a credit toward first-month committed usage. This requires a commitment contract.

Im attaching a draft addendum (legal-friendly, single paragraph amendment) for quick review. If procurement sends a PO referencing this addendum we can start the addendum and open the burst immediately.

Next steps:
- Tell me which option you prefer (addendum + PO OR credit-offset with contract)
- If addendum, procurement can send PO to billing@redwood.com and Ill kick off DocuSign.

Attaching: Draft_Addendum_v2.docx

—Marcus
